title: Maturity self-check profile
description: A per-layer reading of the five-level maturity model (chapter 07 of the AI Governance Engineering Body of Knowledge), as exported by /toolkit/maturity-self-check. Only kind, version and layers[].layer/level are read back on import; the floor and the next move are recomputed. Indicative, not legal advice and not a conformity claim. CC BY 4.0.

kind.description: Identifies the file as a maturity self-check profile.

version.description: Profile format version. A breaking change ships as version 2 at a new URL.

label.description: Optional name for the profile: a team, a platform or a quarter.

model.description: URL of the maturity model the profile was read against.

notice.description: The toolkit's fixed notice, repeated in every export.

layers.description: One reading per stack layer, Layer 1 (Govern-as-Code) to Layer 5 (Assurance & Continuous Compliance).

id.description: Stable layer id (govern-as-code, inventory, evals, runtime, assurance).

name.description: Layer name as chapter 04 states it.

level.description: Highest observable criterion met: 0 for none yet, 1 Documented to 5 Continuous.

levelName.description: Name of the level, null for 0.

criterion.description: The chapter 07 criterion met, verbatim; null for 0.

floor.description: Derived: the weakest layer's level and the layers at it. Recomputed on import.

nextMove.description: Derived: the next cell in the first weakest layer's row, with its pattern. Null when every layer is at Level 5. Recomputed on import.

link.description: Link that reproduces the profile; the answers travel in the URL fragment.
